eligible_governed_inputs: Satoshium Atlas Jurisdiction Record — El Salvador
applicable_rules: Attribution — claims remain attributable to their originating authority.
Provenance — origin, reference, and derivation remain visible.
Scope — evidence may support only propositions within its governed scope.
Authority boundaries — reference does not transfer authority.
Evidence context — evidence is interpreted within its actual temporal, institutional, and representation context.
Traceability — material evaluation conclusions must remain traceable to governed evidence.
Governed change and current-versus-historical state — distinct source states and dates must not be collapsed.
Bounded truth — Attestor may conclude only what the governed evaluation supports within scope.
Independent Attestor evaluation — existing source-institution determinations do not automatically determine the Attestor Evaluation Outcome.
Uncertainty — unresolved evidentiary limitations remain explicit.
Interoperability without authority transfer — Suite relationships may be evaluated without merging institutional authorities.
